thread:
maya: Quick sync — need a short doc update for embedding granularity and a rollback playbook for the upcoming shard migration. Who can own the doc + a tiny examples section?

samir: I can take the doc. will draft an examples section showing 1) per-item vs per-chunk embedding and 2) shard-aware batching examples. ETA today afternoon.

jess: 👍 also add a small note about impact to similarity thresholds when sharding — we saw ~0.03 score drift in perf tests last week. put a concrete example so folks understand "acceptable range".

samir: good call. I’ll add a micro-benchmark table and the quick formula we used to recombine chunk scores.

olivia: For the rollback playbook, can we include the exact CLI steps to revert index sharding, plus the monitoring checks to validate rollback? e.g. short commands, and which dashboards to watch.

ryan: I wrote a tiny rollback script for infra, can paste into the playbook. high level: 1) stop new shard write traffic, 2) rehydrate from last full snapshot, 3) switch read alias, 4) run a smoke set of queries. I’ll add the commands.

samir: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/841 — contains examples, micro-benchmarks, and a separate playbook md under docs/playbooks/embed-shard-rollback.md. Please review.

jess: Reviewing now. One request: add an explicit section "When not to shard" with thresholds (index size < 5M vectors, qps < 50) — otherwise teams will over-shard and see latency regressions.

samir: done, pushed. Also included code snippet for recombining chunked embedding scores:
```python
# recombine chunk scores (weighted mean)
def merge_scores(scores, lengths):
    return sum(s * l for s, l in zip(scores, lengths)) / sum(lengths)
```

olivia: Nice. For the playbook I added the dashboard IDs to watch: dashboard/embed-qps, dashboard/embed-latency, dashboard/embed-accuracy-regression. Also added the smoke test set (50 queries) and acceptance criteria (mean reciprocal rank drop < 0.02).

ryan: Adding infra rollback CLI snippet here so ops can copy:
```
# stop writes
infra-cli service scale --name embed-writer --replicas 0
# restore snapshot
infra-cli snapshot restore --name last-full --target embed-index
# switch alias
infra-cli alias set --index embed-index --alias embed-current
```

maya: This is great. A couple of editorial asks before merge: 1) short TL;DR at top with decision points, 2) add a few inline links to model card compatibility notes (embedding dtype/quantization impacts), 3) confirm PR includes a very small example dataset (5 vectors) people can run locally.

samir: TL;DR added. linked model-card note (https://docs.redwood.ai/model-catalog/embed-compat) and attached example CSV (5 rows) to the PR.

jess: left two tiny comments in the PR about phrasing and the benchmark numbers — mostly nit.

samir: Will fold that in. Planning to merge once jess approves + one more tech review.
